hints.title: Symmetric String Generation by Length
hints.text: Generate reversible number pairs for each target length and verify against string boundary ranges.

hints.title: Recursive Core Expansion with Pair Wrapping
hints.text: Wrap outer pairs (0,0), (1,1), (6,9), (8,8), (9,6) around inner subproblems, excluding leading zeros for the final outer layer.

hints.title: Length-Constrained Backtracking and Range Comparison
hints.text: For each length from len(low) to len(high), generate numbers. When current string reaches target length, check if it falls within [low, high] numerically using string comparison (checking length and lexicographical order). Count valid numbers.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal strobogrammatic number generation expanding outward from centers.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking every number sequentially from low to high takes O(high - low) time which is astronomical.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Generating only symmetric numbers directly tests at most 5^(L/2) candidates.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Avoid leading zero on the outer pair and handle odd vs even lengths recursively.
